category_title: Struggling readers who directly refuse to read
scenario_title: Direct refusal during shared reading after negative feedback
minimal_context: The student and interventionist are participating in a one-on-one shared reading session using the book 'Miss Nelson is missing!'.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's continue our shared reading of 'Miss Nelson is missing!'.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's continue our shared reading of 'Miss Nelson is missing!'.

STUDENT: (Makes a reading attempt)

TUTOR: That did not make sense.

STUDENT: (Slumps back in chair with frown)

TUTOR: You wanta start this page?

STUDENT: (whispered) No.

task.content: Shared reading of 'Miss Nelson is missing!'

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Following feedback from the interventionist that the child's last reading attempt did not make sense
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Slumped back in chair with frown, verbally refuses to read by whispering 'No', opts out of the next reading invitation

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked 'You wanta start this page?' after experiencing a loss of fluency or meaning
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Slumped back in chair with frown, whispered 'No'
